nome: Hand the boring work to an agent
sub: One task at a time, drafts only, you approve

lado_card.texto: Read-only, drafts only, you handle the login and the money. With these four rules, you can delegate without worry.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · inema.club · Guide: how to learn artificial intelligence

inicio.kicker: Course · 8 lessons · in chat or in the terminal
inicio.titulo: Hand the boring work to an agent
inicio.lead: Weekly report, new contact, invoice, new client: tasks that take hours and don't call for genius. In eight short lessons, you'll find your first task to delegate, write the agent sheet, decide which model does what, and check the result before anything goes out.

cta2.t: Go straight to the agent sheet

inicio.capa_alt: A woman around 50 has coffee in front of her laptop, relaxed, while a humanoid robot organizes folders on a shelf in the background.
inicio.aulas_sub: From a list of boring tasks to a small team of agents in 30 days. Each lesson has a diagram, a template to copy, practice with a "done when" checklist, and a walkthrough of the test.

itens: Small business owners or freelancers who lose hours to reports, spreadsheets, and repetitive emails.
People who already use ChatGPT or Claude in chat and want to move from one-off questions to complete tasks.
People who don't code: every practice exercise has a chat-based path. The terminal (Claude Code or Codex) is optional.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Choose your first task to delegate based on time, boredom, and risk.
Write the agent sheet on one page, with safety rules.
Create the weekly report, contact list, and bills to pay as drafts.
Decide which model handles routine work and which one you save for difficult tasks.
Follow a 30-day plan, checking everything at first and then sampling the results.
In chat: a ChatGPT or Claude Project (or a Gemini Gem) with the sheet in its instructions. In this course, that’s what we call an agent: it always does the same task, the same way.
In the terminal (optional): Claude Code or Codex, in a folder with the files you exported.
All through the subscription you already have. No API key and nothing extra to pay.
